Who we are
We are responsible for driving innovation in both our customers' businesses and our employees' work environment by developing and operating AI services for external clients and internal staff.
Responsibilities
In this role, you will design and develop stable AI model serving systems and scalable backend services leveraging state‑of‑the‑art AI/ML models (LLM, Vision, etc.).
You will also build a robust MLOps environment, automate pipelines for efficient operations, and continuously enhance the service through data‑driven performance analysis.
■ AI Model Serving System Development & MLOps Operations
Building GPU‑based model serving systems
Designing and implementing high‑performance model serving architectures using frameworks such as Triton and vLLM
Optimizing serving pipelines to handle large‑scale traffic
Establishing and operating MLOps environments
Operating Kubernetes/container‑based GPU clusters and manage compute resources
Building CI/CD pipelines for AI model deployment
Developing monitoring and logging systems for model serving performance
■ AI Service Backend Platform Development
Developing backend system
Developing backend service platforms using Java, Kotlin, and Spring/Spring Boot
Developing core business logic and common service components for AI services
Designing and integrating APIs
Designing and implementing RESTful API and gRPC interfaces for integration with AI model serving systems
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer engineering or a related field
Minimum 3 years of experience in backend service development
Those who have an understanding of and hands-on experience with container environments such as Docker and Kubernetes
Experience using Java and Kotlin
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in AI model serving and MLOps
Experience in designing, developing, and operating large-scale backend service systems
Experience in building and operating GPU‑based model serving systems using serving frameworks such as Triton and vLLM
Others
[Notes]
In accordance with the employment protection laws, eligible candidates (disabled individuals, veterans, etc.) will receive preferential benefits during the process.

Additional assignments may be given during the interview rounds, if necessary.

The expected position level specified in the job description may change based on each individual's experience and evaluation results.
For any inquiries on recruitment, please refer to the [FAQs] or submit a ticket through '1:1 Inquiries' on our webpage.
[Precautions]
If any of the following conditions apply, your acceptance may be revoked, or you may be subject to disadvantages in the selection process:
If the information submitted during the recruitment process (including the application form) differs or cannot be proven in documentation
If you are ineligible to work under company regulations
If you are ineligible to travel abroad (for men, Korean nationals who have not completed military service or are not exempt from military service by the joining date)
If you are unable to join the company on the start date designated by the company upon receiving the final offer
